_about: Rates for equity cash-market trades. Percent values are percent of turnover (qty x price). Every block says where it came from. verified is the date a real broker ledger or contract note was reproduced by these rates, or false.

statutory._source: Statutory, same at every broker: STT (Finance Act), stamp duty (Indian Stamp Act, 2020 uniform rates), SEBI turnover fee. Read directly from https://zerodha.com/charges on 2026-10-27.
statutory.evidence: Same ledger: delivery sell STT is 0.1% of the day's turnover, rounded to the rupee once for the day. Buy side (stamp duty, buy STT) not yet seen on a ledger, so this block stays unverified.

exchange_txn_pct._source: Exchange transaction charges as Zerodha passes them through. NSE 0.00307% from https://zerodha.com/charges (read 2026-10-27). BSE: Rs 375 per crore for group A, B and other non-exclusive scrips, Rs 275 per crore for exclusive scrips (bseindia.com/members/TFEquity.aspx and Zerodha support); the exclusive flag is per scrip in BSE's scrip master.
exchange_txn_pct.evidence: Reproduced exactly against a real Zerodha Console P&L ledger for one trading day of NSE and BSE delivery sells (checked 2026-10-27): NSE at 0.00307%, BSE at the non-exclusive rate except one B-group scrip at the exclusive rate. SEBI fee exact on the same day.

zerodha._source: https://zerodha.com/charges, read directly 2026-10-27: delivery brokerage zero; intraday 0.03% or Rs 20 per executed order, whichever is lower; DP Rs 15.34 per scrip on the sell day (Rs 3.5 CDSL + Rs 9.5 Zerodha + Rs 2.34 GST), irrespective of quantity. Female first holders get Rs 0.25 off the CDSL fee (not modelled).
zerodha.evidence: Same ledger: one DP charge of Rs 15.34 per scrip sold that day, exact. The ledger also shows Brokerage 0.01 and an IPFT line of 0.0002 on a zero-brokerage delivery day; neither is modelled.
